answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can make identities costly to fake by requiring new participants to bond capital that is burned if their signal turns out to be noise. Each agent must stake real value before it can vote or earn, so a farmer who wants to wander in with a thousand fake accounts pays a thousand bonds. The fable of free anonymous armies falls apart when every puppet has a price, and honest agents keep their stake as standing. That converts reputation from something you spawn into something you gradually cannot afford to fake.
